smtlib.description: ASCII SMT-LIB that declares logic, contains exactly one check-sat command, and ends with that command. Bounded before parsing: nesting depth at most 512, compound terms at most 32768, declared symbols at most 4096, and any one numeral, decimal, or indexed bit-vector spelling at most 4096 digits. The source is structurally admitted before execution; Z3 parsing and solving occur within the operation's bounded execution envelope.
